# Doubo (都播)

> {{ en.meta.description }}

Doubo is a native IPTV / M3U playlist player, available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac (SwiftUI and AVKit), with Android phones, tablets, and Android TV / TV boxes coming soon. It plays M3U / M3U8 playlists that users add themselves (by URL or file); it does not bundle or sell any channels. Highlights: grouped channel browsing, search and favorites, parallel channel checks, switching between multiple sources of the same channel, Picture in Picture, subtitle tracks, playback speed, a built-in universal TV remote that discovers and controls Roku, Samsung, LG and DLNA TVs over the local network (and also finds Chromecast, AirPlay and Android TV devices), catch-up / replay where the source provides it, multi-quality HLS selection (auto/high/medium/low), dual audio (watch one feed's picture with another feed's sound), per-channel HTTP headers (User-Agent / Referer), Xtream Codes login, cached playlists with offline fallback and clear network error messages, DLNA casting to smart TVs, local video playback, and on-device storage with no ads or analytics SDKs. Apple TV and CarPlay versions are planned.
